title: Make The String Great
description:
[Source: LeetCode 1544]
A good string does not have two adjacent characters s[i] and s[i + 1] where s[i] is a lower-case letter and s[i + 1] is the same letter but in upper-case or vice-versa. Return the string after making it good.

Input Format:
A string s

Output Format:
The great string
